rejected.finding: NSF award amount and dates from the award API
rejected.reason: The nsf.gov award page rendered empty and the API values have no verbatim sentence around them. The release's about $200,000 over two years (c13) stands.
The release does not say who made the model called Chronos. c25 states only what the Chronos paper says about itself, and no copy may link the two as fact.
The release names Commerce, Texas, not a county. The record files the item under Hunt County, which contains Commerce. No slide names the county.
